items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I stopped playing with Anna all around about 29... I played with Anna on.

ctx.x: that must have been when in the early twenties

no that was um in the late in the late twenties And regularly after Chris, I think Chris died in 37 or 27 or 28. Yeah. And I stopped playing with Anna all around about 29. I think about 29. After Chris died with the band that went to nothing. Well I went with Anna on the pad. That's when the pressure was playing with me. The pressure first started cramping down on me. I played with Anna on. Because the pressure knocked that out. Things got so tough, well, getting no way so.
